maps.points.mines_under_forest.detail: You push through the rubble into a dark stone chamber. Several figures wear Tattered Robe turn towards you. Their skin hangs loose from their rotten flesh, and their lifeless eyes stare at you intently. Perhaps they were once adventurers, but now they have become something even worse.
maps.points.mines_under_forest.detail-3: You enter a low chamber lit by a dying torch. Crates and barrels are piled against the walls. The air reeks of sweat, smoke, and fresh blood.
maps.points.mines_under_forest.detail-5: You enter a dark stone chamber. Several figures dressed in…Tattered Robe turn towards you. Their skin hangs loose from their rotten flesh, and their lifeless eyes stare at you intently. Perhaps they were once adventurers, but now they have become something even worse.
maps.points.mines_under_forest.dialogue: You break through the rubble into a dark chamber. Several figures in tattered robes turn toward you. Their skin hangs loose from rotting flesh, and their lifeless eyes fix upon you. Once adventurers, perhaps. Now something far worse.
maps.points.mines_under_forest.dialogue-: So run. Unless you think you can charm the dead.
You enter a low chamber lit by a dying torch. Crates and barrels are piled against the walls. The air reeks of sweat, smoke, and fresh blood.
A broad-shouldered orc storms into the room. For a brief second, his eyes widen in surprise. But only for a second.
His surprise quickly turns to anger. He tightens his grip on the axe and lets out a threatening growl. Orcs aren't known for warm welcomes. You're about to be reminded why.

You enter a dark chamber. Several figures in tattered robes turn toward you. Their skin hangs loose from rotting flesh, and their lifeless eyes fix upon you. Once adventurers, perhaps. Now something far worse.
